I am a Professor of Biological Sciences at the University of Southern Maine with a background in geometric morphometrics, biomechanical modeling of swimming and flying animals, and modeling performance trade-offs in functional systems. More recently, I’ve worked on developing tools for best statistical practices in bench biology.

## Education

Stony Brook University| Stony Brook, NY
PhD in Anatomical Sciences | 1995

University of Pennsylvania | Philadelphia PA
B.A in Geology | 1988

## Research Interests

* good science in ecology, evolution, and cell biology
* developing tools for best statistical practices
* being a research parasite
